verdict.rationale: Firstbase's own docs state "Foreign qualification available in all 50 states." They also say that to expand to a new state you select it on the compliance dashboard and "we'll take care of it for you," so the provider handles the filing itself. Per-state registered-agent coverage at $299 per state/year supports operating in the added state. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the foreign-qualification process and turnaround, foreign-qualification-specific pricing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
